name: Crystal Shore
summary: Crystal Shore faces the South Seas along Stranglethorn's southeastern coast. Its beach lies south of the Ruins of Aboraz and across the water from Jaguero Isle.

sections.title: A Secluded Coastal Strip
sections.body: At Stranglethorn Vale's southeastern edge, jungle meets the South Seas along Crystal Shore. Steep ridges divide the beach from the inland wilds of Mistvale Valley, though a couple of rugged passes cross them. The crumbling troll structures of the Ruins of Aboraz stand to the north, while the Wild Shore follows the cape's southern curves. Far from Booty Bay's docks, this coast remains quiet and windswept.

faq.q: Where is the Crystal Shore located?
faq.answer: Crystal Shore runs along Stranglethorn Vale's far southeastern coast, facing the South Seas. It lies south of the Ruins of Aboraz and northeast of the Wild Shore.

faq.q: How do you access the Crystal Shore from inland?
aliases: how to get to crystal shore
faq.answer: A steep ridge separates Crystal Shore from the mainland jungle. A couple of narrow natural passes cross the cliffs, including a trail into Mistvale Valley.
The ancient Ruins of Aboraz lie just north of Crystal Shore, and Jaguero Isle sits across the channel to the southwest. The Wild Shore continues down the coast to the south.

faq.q: Is the Crystal Shore settled by any faction?
faq.answer: No faction maintains a town or settlement along Crystal Shore. Native wildlife, the ancient troll ruins to the north and the South Seas shape this untamed beach.
